title: table to graph
explanation:
### Description

Demonstrate vtkTableToGraph with multiple link configurations on author data.

**dataset → input → filter → layout → filter → visual_asset → renderer → infrastructure → output**

- [vtkActor](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkActor.html) — assigns the mapped geometry to the scene.
- [vtkBitArray](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkBitArray.html) — bit array.
- [vtkCircularLayoutStrategy](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkCircularLayoutStrategy.html) — circular layout strategy.
- [vtkDataObject](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkDataObject.html) — provides field association constants for array processing.
- [vtkDelimitedTextReader](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkDelimitedTextReader.html) — delimited text reader.
- [vtkGlyph3D](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkGlyph3D.html) — places oriented, scaled glyphs at each point.
- [vtkGlyphSource2D](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkGlyphSource2D.html) — glyph source2d.
- [vtkGraphLayout](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkGraphLayout.html) — graph layout.
- [vtkGraphToPolyData](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkGraphToPolyData.html) — graph to poly data.
- [vtkIntArray](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkIntArray.html) — int array.
- [vtkMergeTables](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkMergeTables.html) — merge tables.
- [vtkMutableUndirectedGraph](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkMutableUndirectedGraph.html) — mutable undirected graph.
- [vtkPoints](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkPoints.html) — stores 3D point coordinates.
- [vtkPolyDataMapper](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkPolyDataMapper.html) — maps polygonal data to graphics primitives.
- [vtkStringArray](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkStringArray.html) — string array.
- [vtkStringToCategory](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkStringToCategory.html) — string to category.
- [vtkTable](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkTable.html) — table.
- [vtkTableToGraph](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkTableToGraph.html) — table to graph.
- [vtkUndirectedGraph](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkUndirectedGraph.html) — undirected graph.
- [vtkRenderWindow](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderWindow.html) — displays the rendered scene in a window on screen.
- [vtkRenderWindowInteractor](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderWindowInteractor.html) — captures mouse and keyboard events.
- [vtkRenderer](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderer.html) — assembles the scene and configures the camera.
- `Initialize()` and `Start()` launch the interactive visualization — `Initialize()` prepares the interactor and `Start()` begins the event loop.
